info.title: LinqContraband.Scan — scan a .NET solution for EF Core query problems
info.description: Scan any .NET solution for EF Core LINQ problems without adding a package: `dnx LinqContraband.Scan` builds it with the LinqContraband analyzers injected and prints a ranked report of N+1 queries, client-side evaluation, sync-over-async, missing AsNoTracking, raw SQL injection risks and more, plus a SARIF file for GitHub code scanning.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Where to write the SARIF 2.1.0 report. Default: linqcontraband.sarif

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework to build (passed to dotnet build).

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Leave out findings in matching files, such as '**/Migrations/**' or 'tests/**'.
Repeat it for more globs. A glob without '/' matches a file or folder name.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
Exit with code 1 when a finding is at least this severe: error, warning or info.
Default: none (exit 0 whatever the scan finds).

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
A SARIF report from an earlier scan. Only findings it does not have are listed
and count for --fail-on; the new SARIF report marks each finding new or unchanged.

options.name: --fix
options.description:
Apply the code fixes first (with dotnet format), then report what is left.
Edits your source files: commit or stash first, and review the diff.
--rules, --skip-rules and --exclude limit what is fixed.

options.name: --html
options.description: Also write the report as one HTML page, with the code around each finding.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Also write the report as Markdown, for a pull request comment or a wiki.

options.name: --no-github
options.description: In GitHub Actions, skip the job summary and the pull request annotations.

options.name: --findings
options.description: Findings to list under each rule, with the line of code. Default: 3

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of files to list under "Most affected files". Default: 10

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show the full dotnet build output.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version (the analyzer the tool runs has the same version).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Solution (.sln/.slnx), project, or directory. Default: current directory.
